captions.detailed: A realistic camera zoom lens with a matte black cylindrical barrel. It features two thick, ribbed, rotating bands representing the zoom and focus rings, which spin continuously around the central axis. On the side of the main barrel, there is a small raised switch panel containing two light gray sliding toggle switches for focus mode and image stabilization that slide along local linear tracks.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a stabilized camera zoom lens. The model should include a main black cylindrical barrel, a rotating zoom ring, a rotating focus ring, and two small, functional side switch levers that slide to represent stabilization and focus controls.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by building a base cylinder for the main lens barrel. Two larger, ribbed cylindrical shells are created to act as the zoom and focus rings, which are attached using continuous rotational joints coaxial with the main barrel. A rectangular switch panel is extruded on the side of the barrel, and two small sliding switch levers (constructed from box primitives) are attached via prismatic joints to slide along the switch panel's vertical axis.
